title: The Brushfire Problem: How Small Operational Failures Burn Down Your Week
note: Render on the Mac: BlogAnnounce.tsx + the cloned voice. Output blog-announce-video.mp4 into this folder.

beats.vo: One missed handoff and your entire week quietly falls apart.
That is not a productivity problem — it is a systems problem.
The visible crisis is never the root cause — it is the symptom.
Audit handoffs, approvals, and recurring tasks before you touch any tool.
Tools on a broken process just make the breaking faster.
Full breakdown is in the blog — link is in the comments.
